name: Connections Care Management
desc: Care management practice serving northern New Jersey and Rockland County, NY. Care assessments and care plans, ongoing care management, hospital discharge planning, dementia care management, help choosing assisted living or other housing, in-home care coordination, medical advocacy, benefits paperwork and crisis help. They meet clients at home, in the hospital, in rehab or in a care community.

name: Umbrella Care Management
desc: Geriatric care management and patient advocacy for seniors and people with disabilities. Services include comprehensive assessments, care planning, care coordination, patient advocacy and crisis intervention, plus coordination of medical services, home safety evaluations and in-home welfare checks. The team includes a registered nurse (RN).

name: VNS Health Geriatric Care Management
desc: Geriatric care management for older adults and the families who care for them. Care managers assess needs, write care plans, arrange and supervise care, go to medical appointments and oversee medications, help with bills, insurance claims and paperwork, and advise families on care decisions, including researching long-term care facilities. Care managers are nurses or social workers certified through the Commission for Case Manager Certification.

name: WJCS Senior Care Management
desc: Senior care management from Westchester Jewish Community Services, a nonprofit in White Plains, to help older adults age safely at home. Services include in-home assessments, personalized care planning, case management, guidance on senior living options, and information and referrals. Senior Services is directed by a licensed clinical social worker (LCSW). Ask for extension 2340.

name: Urban Eldercare
desc: Aging Life Care management for families caring for older adults in Manhattan, brownstone Brooklyn and Riverdale. Services include care management and dementia care guidance. The practice is a member of the Aging Life Care Association.

name: Peacewell Care Consulting
desc: Aging Life Care management for older adults and their families on Long Island, in Nassau and Suffolk counties. The practice is led by a registered nurse and certified care manager (RN, CCM) and is a member of the Aging Life Care Association.

name: Care Specialists
desc: Geriatric care management for older adults and families on Long Island and in the New York City area. Services include comprehensive assessment, consultation, counseling, care planning and advocacy for people coping with chronic illness, frailty, disability, dementia or functional decline. The care manager is a New York State licensed social worker and occupational therapist, and the practice follows the Aging Life Care Association's standards of practice.

name: Long Island Geriatric Services
desc: Geriatric care management on Long Island, based in Syosset. Services include in-home visits and geriatric evaluations, dementia assessments, help finding assisted living and other housing, hospital and rehab discharge planning, coordination and supervision of in-home caregivers, counseling and help with Medicaid applications. Staff include a licensed geriatric social worker and a certified geriatric care manager.

name: HealthSense
desc: Nurse-led Aging Life Care management in New York City, based on Madison Avenue in Manhattan. Services include health care advocacy, memory care, end of life care, benefit navigation and help with transitions of care. Care managers are registered nurses (RN), and the practice is a member of the Aging Life Care Association.

name: Directions in Aging
desc: Geriatric care management for older adults and families in Westchester County. Services include eldercare consultations at home, at the office or by phone, geriatric assessments with care plans and referrals, home care coordination, oversight of residents in assisted living and nursing homes, end of life guidance and help with moves to a senior residence or nursing home. The founder is a licensed master social worker (LMSW, C-ASWCM) with Advanced member status in the Aging Life Care Association.

name: Aging With Dignity NY
desc: Care management for older adults in Manhattan, Brooklyn, Queens and the Bronx. Services include care management, memory care, home care coordination, crisis services and help with transitions. The care manager is Care Manager Certified (CMC) and a member of the Aging Life Care Association.

name: ElderCare Advocacy
desc: A geriatric care management practice on Staten Island. Services include geriatric care management, family consultations and evaluations, placement and discharge planning, Medicaid and pooled trust help, fair hearings and CDPAP guidance. It is led by a licensed clinical social worker who is Care Manager Certified (LCSW, CMC).

name: NorthStar Care & Guidance
desc: Geriatric care management for older adults, people with disabilities and their families in the New York City metro area and northern New Jersey. Services include care assessment and planning, arranging personal care, end of life care planning, advocacy for public and private benefits, help with care decisions, bill paying and placement help. The practice is directed by a licensed clinical social worker (LCSW).

name: The Elder Expert
desc: Elder care consulting and care management for older adults and families in Bergen County, NJ and Rockland County, NY. Services include in-home and psychosocial assessments, placement recommendations for assisted living, rehab and nursing facilities, and advice on Medicare and Medicaid. The consultant is a licensed clinical social worker (LCSW, C-ASWCM) affiliated with the Aging Life Care Association.

name: Care Collective Nursing & Care Management
desc: Nursing and care management under one roof for older adults and families in Manhattan, Brooklyn, Queens and Westchester. Services include planning to age well, aging in place, medical advocacy, care coordination and support for family caregivers. The team includes a licensed master social worker (LMSW, CCM) and a registered nurse (RN, CCM).

name: Reddi-Care Connections
desc: Aging Life Care management for older adults in Westchester County, NY and Fairfield County, CT. Services include caregiving consultations for families who live far away, comprehensive evaluations, dementia care, management and monitoring, help with living placement and family counseling and mediation. The care manager holds LMSW and CMC credentials.

name: Pinnacle Senior Care Solutions
desc: Geriatric care management and nursing consultation for older adults and families in Nassau, Suffolk, Westchester and the five boroughs. Services include geriatric care management, home nursing assessments, PRI and screen assessments for nursing home placement, wound care consultation and help choosing between staying at home, assisted living or a nursing facility. The founder is a registered nurse (RN).

name: Home Again Transitions
desc: Move managers serving Westchester who help with move planning and floor plans, sorting and downsizing, choosing and supervising movers, packing and unpacking, and setting up the new home. They also arrange sale, donation or disposal of unwanted items and clear and clean the former home. The site says it is recognized by NASMM, the National Association of Senior Move Managers.

name: Organize Me, Inc.
desc: Organizing and move management company serving New York City and the greater NYC area. Senior move management covers downsizing, space and furniture planning, packing and unpacking, donations, shredding papers and getting the old home ready for sale. They also offer estate clearance.

name: Paper Moon Moves
desc: New York City company offering senior moves, downsizing, estate clearouts and aging in place help. For a move they make a floor plan of the new home, help sort and decide what to keep, donate or sell, hire and oversee movers, and unpack and set up the new place. The site lists NASMM among its affiliations.

name: 123Organize
desc: Organizing and move management company with senior move management for people leaving a longtime home. Help includes a move plan and floor plan, sorting and deciding what to keep, ship, donate or sell, estate sale and clear out coordination, packing and unpacking, and supervising move day. The site shows NASMM and NAPO member logos.

name: Caring Transitions of Syracuse
desc: Local office serving Onondaga County, including Syracuse, Cicero, Clay, Baldwinsville, Manlius, Camillus and DeWitt. Services include senior relocation and packing, resettling in the new home, downsizing and space planning, decluttering, estate sales and online auctions, and estate cleanouts. The site says every franchise has a Certified Relocation and Transition Specialist (CRTS) on staff and shows the NASMM emblem.

name: Elder Transition Consulting
desc: Senior move management for older adults and their families in the Buffalo and Rochester areas. Services include consulting and downsizing, estate clean outs and aging in place help. The site says the team follows the NASMM Code of Ethics and lists NASMM membership.

name: Glimmerglass Move Managers
desc: Senior move managers serving Otsego County and nearby communities. They coordinate local or out of state moves, help with decluttering and downsizing, make space and furniture plans for the new home, shred old records, and sell belongings to buyers and dealers or through estate sales and online auctions. The site says it is a member of the National Association of Senior & Specialty Move Managers.

name: Hither Hive
desc: Manhattan based company offering senior and specialty move management and senior downsizing in New York City, East Hampton and beyond, for people moving from a longtime home to a senior community or smaller place. The site shows NASMM and NAPO badges.

name: Home Hands of Rochester
desc: Senior downsizing and move management by the company's own team across greater Rochester and the Finger Lakes, from Brighton, Greece and Webster to Victor, Canandaigua and Naples. They plan furniture for the new home, hold sorting sessions, pack, manage move day, then unpack, set up the kitchen and make the beds. The site says it is a member of the National Association of Senior & Specialty Move Managers.

name: Never Move Alone
desc: Move management company in Delaware County that specializes in senior moves. Services include rightsizing and decluttering, move management, and dispersal of household items. The site says it is an insured and bonded member of NASMM.

name: SAMMS
desc: Senior move managers serving Nassau and Suffolk counties on Long Island. For assisted living moves they plan the new apartment, help choose what to bring, coordinate with the community and licensed movers, pack, unpack and set up the room. Downsizing help covers sorting, space planning, estate sales, donations and buyouts, and readying the family home for sale. The site says it is a NASMM member.

name: RDM Move Managers
desc: Family owned company offering senior downsizing and move management alongside home remediation, serving families in Dutchess, Putnam, Rockland and Westchester counties. They make a plan for the move, help sort what to keep, donate or sell, pack and label boxes, hire and supervise movers, and coordinate with the new building. Their downsizing service also sells unwanted items, collects donation tax forms and clears the house for sale. The site says it is a member of NASMM.

name: Aging Well ElderCare Specialists
desc: Aging Life Care management in the Buffalo Niagara region, including Buffalo, Amherst, Clarence, East Aurora, Orchard Park, Niagara Falls and Lockport. Care managers help families make a plan, manage and prevent crises, address memory loss, recommend care options and support aging in place. The owner is a nationally Certified Geriatric Care Manager (CMC), and the practice is a member of the Aging Life Care Association.

name: Aging Well Rochester
desc: Geriatric care management in the Rochester area since 1988, serving Monroe and Ontario counties. Services cover aging in place, dementia care, crisis help after a hospital or rehab stay, and help choosing memory care, assisted living or a nursing home. The team includes licensed master social workers (LMSW), registered nurses (RN) and Certified Care Managers (CMC), and the practice is a member of the Aging Life Care Association.

name: Together in Caring Rochester
desc: Care management for older adults from a Rochester office serving Monroe, Ontario, Wayne, Livingston and Yates counties. Services include medical, cognitive and safety assessments (including PRI and screens), care coordination, help with senior living moves, aging in place support and advocacy. Staff include registered nurses (RN), a licensed master social worker (LMSW) and Certified Care Managers (CMC), and the president is an Advanced Professional Member of the Aging Life Care Association.

name: Together in Caring Syracuse
desc: Care management for older adults from a Syracuse office serving Onondaga, Madison, Oswego, Oneida, Cortland and Cayuga counties. Services include medical, cognitive and safety assessments (including PRI and screens), care coordination, help with senior living moves, aging in place support and advocacy. Staff include registered nurses (RN), a licensed master social worker (LMSW) and Certified Care Managers (CMC), and the president is an Advanced Professional Member of the Aging Life Care Association.

name: Together in Caring Albany
desc: Care management for older adults from an Albany office serving the Capital District. Services include medical, cognitive and safety assessments (including PRI and screens), care coordination, help with senior living moves, aging in place support and advocacy. Staff include a PRI nurse (RN) and Certified Care Managers (CMC), and the president is an Advanced Professional Member of the Aging Life Care Association.

name: Seniors Choice Care
desc: Geriatric care management, also known as Aging Life Care, for older adults in Rochester, Webster and the rest of Monroe County. Services include dementia care guidance, medication management, PRI assessments, household finance and record keeping, insurance and long-term care claim help, and relocation help. The care consultants are registered nurses (RN).

name: Senior Care Consultation Services
desc: Geriatric care consultation for older adults and families in Suffolk County, with a Setauket mailing address. Services include comprehensive assessments and long-term care planning, Medicaid planning and applications, help with Medicare, Medigap and long-term care insurance, PRI and screen forms, admission arrangements for nursing homes and assisted living, and care monitoring for families who live far away. The team includes a licensed clinical social worker and Certified Care Manager (LCSW, CMC), a registered nurse (RN) and a geriatric nurse practitioner.
